name: Extended Combat Meditation
prerequisites: Wis 13, Combat Meditation, Meditation Master, character level 9th
benefit: Add your Wisdom bonus (if any) to the number of rounds that you gain the benefits of your meditation feats when using Combat Meditation.
flavor: You are able to glean insight from your momentary meditation for longer than most can.
